liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Blues For Allah (sans vocals)** (2 reviews): Merl Saunders' keyboard work elevates Garcia's playing during these jazzy jams; Keith's keyboard work was exceptional, avoiding repetitive six or seven note patterns [16][18]
- **Stronger than Dirt** (1 review): The sequence featuring drums and Stronger Than Dirt is outstanding with significant power [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1975-03-23.sbd.snack.18525.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 13 songs; 72 min; rated 3.92/5 by 12 [1]
- **gd1975-03-23.fm.lee-smith.94026.sbeok.flac16**: FM broadcast; 9 songs; 49 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: This FM recording lacks the tinny quality found in other pre-FM sources [11]
- **gd1975-03-23.pre-fm-sbd.hope-ross.32539.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 8 songs; 38 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1975-03-23.126296.fm.kafer-boswell-smith.flac24**: FM broadcast; 8 songs; 49 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Jerry Garcia mentioned Crosby was with the band, but Crosby never showed up [1]
- The show was a benefit for SNACK, featuring Merl Saunders and Ned Lagin [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1975-03-23.sbd.snack.18525.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Unknown; source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd1975-03-23.fm.lee-smith.94026.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Peter Kafer; transferred by Matt Smith and Pat Lee; source: FM Radio Broadcast > Master Reel (@ 7 1/2 ips) [2]. Also: Peter Kafer brought his master up for Pat to copy around that time [2]
- **gd1975-03-23.pre-fm-sbd.hope-ross.32539.shnf**: source: Pre-FM SBD MR>DAT>Digi-Remaster>CD>CD>EAC>MKW>SHN [4]. Also: Dave Hope-Ross ripped and encoded the files, sharing them on Further Music Network [4]
- **gd1975-03-23.126296.fm.kafer-boswell-smith.flac24**: transferred by Matt Smith; source: FMMR (Peter Kafer) @ 7 1/2 ips > R @ 7 1/2 ips (Will Boswell); Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre pair Tesla tubes… [3]
